name: Lovastatin
route_note: oral tablet with the evening meal; extended-release form at bedtime

discovery.note: Isolated from the fungus Aspergillus terreus; Akira Endo independently found the same compound (monacolin K) in Monascus ruber.

tagline: The first statin approved anywhere, a fungal metabolite from Aspergillus terreus
summary: Lovastatin is a natural statin produced by the fungus Aspergillus terreus and was the first HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor approved for clinical use, in 1987. It lowers LDL cholesterol and is also the main active compound in red yeast rice.
mechanism: Lovastatin is an inactive lactone that is hydrolysed to its beta-hydroxy acid, a structural mimic of HMG-CoA that competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase.

Falling intracellular cholesterol activates SREBP-2, which increases expression of LDL receptors on hepatocytes. More receptors clear more LDL particles from the blood, lowering LDL cholesterol; statins also modestly lower triglycerides and raise HDL.
uses: Primary prevention of coronary heart disease

history.title: Compactin
history.detail: Akira Endo at Sankyo discovers mevastatin (compactin), the first statin, in Penicillium citrinum.

history.title: Lovastatin isolated
history.detail: Merck isolates mevinolin (lovastatin) from Aspergillus terreus.

history.title: Trials halted
history.detail: Merck suspends development after reports of tumours in dogs given compactin; work later resumes.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Mevacor becomes the first statin approved by the FDA (August).

history.title: AFCAPS/TexCAPS
history.detail: Lovastatin reduces first coronary events in people with average cholesterol.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic lovastatin becomes available in the US.

history.title: Endo dies
history.detail: Akira Endo, who discovered the first statin, dies in June.

facts: Red yeast rice supplements contain monacolin K, chemically identical to lovastatin.
Akira Endo received the Lasker-DeBakey Clinical Medical Research Award in 2008 for discovering statins.
